title: Match rules
description: data/rules/match.json: match-wide gameplay values, copied into MatchRules (developer settings, compared before online matches). Editor aid only: Sim.Data's validator is authoritative (src/Sim.Data/Rules).

roundStartDistance.description: Each fighter's distance from the stage centre when a round starts, in subpixels; less than wallDistance.

wallDistance.description: Each stage wall's distance from the stage centre, in subpixels. Fighters' pushboxes stay between the walls.

maxPlayerDistance.description: The farthest the fighters may stand apart, outer pushbox edge to outer pushbox edge, in subpixels: the width the logic camera sees. At most twice wallDistance, more than twice roundStartDistance.

tradeRule.description: When both fighters' attacks connect on the same frame: trade = both hits land, clash = neither lands (both attacks are spent).

roundTimerFrames.description: Round timer length in logic frames (99 s = 5940). It stops during a global freeze; when it runs out, the larger share of max health left wins the round (equal = draw).

roundsToWin.description: Round wins that win the match (2 = best of 3). A draw gives both players a round win, unless that would give both their last win: then an extra deciding round is played.

maxRounds.description: The last round a match can reach (only through extra rounds after draws); still undecided after it, the match is a draw. At least 2 x roundsToWin - 1.

roundOverFrames.description: Frames between a KO or time-out and the next round (or match over). The logic keeps running with neutral input so the KO'd fighter can fall and land.
